description: Add CLI enhancements to ralph.py: a VERSION file, --version flag, and --list-projects flag.

userStories.title: Create VERSION file
userStories.description: Create a plain-text file at ralph/VERSION containing the current semver string '0.1.0'. This file is the single source of truth for ralph's version number.
acceptanceCriteria: Contents are exactly '0.1.0' (no trailing newline issues — strip() == '0.1.0')
userStories.notes: Created ralph/VERSION file containing '0.1.0' as the single source of truth for ralph's version number. File verified to contain exactly '0.1.0' (strip() == '0.1.0'). Committed with message 'feat: US-001 — create VERSION file with semver 0.1.0'.

userStories.title: Add --version flag to ralph.py
userStories.description: Add a --version flag to ralph.py's argparse setup. When invoked with --version, ralph prints the version string read from ralph/VERSION and exits cleanly (exit code 0). The slug argument must become optional (nargs='?') so --version works without a project slug.
acceptanceCriteria: When --version is passed, the script reads ralph/VERSION and prints the version
slug argument uses nargs='?' so --version works standalone
Script exits with code 0 after printing version
userStories.notes: Fixed manually — added --version flag to argparse; reads ralph/VERSION and prints via sys.exit(0). Verified: python3 ralph.py --version prints '0.1.0'.

userStories.title: Add --list-projects flag to ralph.py
userStories.description: Add a --list-projects flag to ralph.py's argparse setup. When invoked, ralph calls prd_manager.list_active_projects() and prints each project slug on its own line, then exits cleanly. The function list_active_projects() already exists in prd_manager.py — import and call it directly.
acceptanceCriteria: When --list-projects is passed, calls list_active_projects() from prd_manager
Each project slug is printed on its own line
Script exits with code 0 after listing
userStories.notes: US-003 implemented: Added --list-projects flag to ralph.py. Changes: (1) Added list_active_projects to imports from prd_manager, (2) Added --list-projects argument to argparse, (3) Added handler that calls list_active_projects() and prints each slug on its own line, then exits with code 0.
